name: multiple_choice: Which of the following statements is accurate of the…

request.questionText: Which of the following statements is accurate of the image below (Figure 9.3 from our textbook)?

choices.label: A
choices.text: All of the other answer choices are accurate.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Each of the vertical bars represents a single confidence interval from a single sample.

choices.label: C
choices.text: This figure illustrates the use of Monte Carlo simulation to assess whether bootstrapping satisfies the "coverage principle."

choices.label: D
choices.text: This figure illustrates that bootstrapping sometimes produces confidence intervals that do not contain the "truth", i.e., the population estimand.
